svg.title: Fig. 149(e) — Curves parallel to the lemniscate
svg.desc: Redrawn from Robert C. Yates, A Handbook on Curves and Their Properties (1947), Fig. 149(e), page 157. Section: parallel.

g.data-text: The lemniscate (thin), with its node at the centre.
At a series of points of both loops take the normal (the faint lines) and lay off k along it on both sides.
Draw the parallel curves: the outer branch is a large oval with a waist, the inner branch is pinched at the ends of the loops, where k is greater than the radius of curvature (a/3).
